question: What is the state of the art system mentioned?

answer.free_form_answer:
Two knowledge-based systems,
two traditional word expert supervised systems, six recent neural-based systems, and one BERT feature-based system.

title: GlossBERT: BERT for Word Sense Disambiguation with Gloss Knowledge
answer_rationale: Text 3 and Text 7 both state that the proposed method involves fine-tuning the pre-trained BERT model and achieving new state-of-the-art results on the WSD task, indicating that the state-of-the-art system is the BERT-based approach.
